plot_tree_decision_tree: plot a fitted decision tree classifier or regressor with matplotlib, customizing node colors, depth, and labels
export_graphviz_tree: export a fitted decision tree to GraphViz DOT format as a string or file, with options for filled nodes, rounded corners, and depth limits
export_text_tree: generate a text-based hierarchical report of decision tree rules, showing splits, class predictions, and sample counts
create_decision_tree_export_config: configure decision tree export parameters including feature names, class names, node labels, filled colors, and precision settings
review_tree_node_representation: review how tree nodes are converted to string representations with impurity, samples, values, and class information for visualization
